rows.en: Lyle: "So this is all you can manage against Gadran..."
Ymir: "Everyone! We couldn't finish the repairs in time,
so this will be a tough fight! Do your best!"
Arthur: "Still, it helps that they restored us even a little."
Yamato: "We'll have to be careful whenever we fight consecutive battles..."
Fain: "Anyway, we have no choice! Let's go!"
We're hurrying to restart it, but it looks like
Touya: "I see. We'll manage on our own for now..."
Touya: "True. Looks like he's more than just appearances."
Aurelie: "Oh? You can already sense Prana,
Aurelie: "...You don't realize it, huh...? Well, never mind.
Touya: "Huh? What the hell are you babbling about?
Lyle: "...A ghost from a hundred years ago."
There's no way you can defeat me."
Lyle: "Spirit Mechs? Heh... Heh heh heh... Very well.
Let's see just how good those vaunted Spirit Mechs of yours
Reduce: "Yes. So that's a ≪Ze=Ode≫... What a
sinister presence... Yet I feel no revulsion... Why?"
Ciel: "The pilot's intense feelings make it seem that way... Hatred...
Is this... what Lord Garyud was talking about?"
Lyle: "Why are you fighting in a toy like that?
Stop making me wait and bring that thing out."
Touya: "What the hell are you talking about?"
Let's see how long that confidence lasts."
But this guy is unbelievably strong..."
Touya: "Ghh... What the hell can we do...?"
Arthur: "Our attacks don't seem to be working...
That field-like thing that appeared for a moment
seems to be reducing their effect."
Still, this is rather bad for us..."
Xiujian: "...I'm surprised, believe it or not."
Xiujian: (...What should I do? At this rate...)
Lyle: "That's all you've got...? What a joke."
Aurelie: "You're kidding... Can we even beat this thing?!"
Touya: "All right, he's the only one left, but..."
Lyle: "...So this is all you amount to..."
Yamato: "Huh? Wait, what are you planning?"
Touya: "I'm starting to get a feel for how to use Prana.
I'll put every bit of Prana I have into Zeulear and slam it into him.
How do you come up with such reckless ideas?"
Touya: "Well, I'm ready to go down fighting. If only a miracle happens..."
Yamato: "...Touya. Obstacles are there to be overcome,
and miracles are called miracles because they really do happen.
We'll manage! If we believe, I'm sure we will!"
D-Did I manage to get out...?"
Lyle: "...L-Lenis? No, that's wrong... It can't be...?!
Heh heh heh heh... Haaah hah hah hah hah!
I see! So that's it, Lenis!
How long will you keep getting in my way...? My...!
This is Her Majesty's will. Then I cannot allow anyone to interfere."
Lyle: "So you're the Sword Radiance, Phantom Saint,
Garyud... Heh heh heh... I'll give you credit for your courage.
But in the end, you're only human... You're no match for Rayode."
Garyud: "We won't know until we try."
Garyud: "I don't know the meaning of that word."
Garyud: "...Tch. So it's no use after all...?"
Touya: "This is... the one from back then..."
Touya: "You want... me to pilot you...?"
Touya: "I'll try getting it to move!"
Lyle: "Heh heh heh... What's wrong? Won't it move?
Well, it makes no difference to me... Hmm?"
Touya: "Ai?! What are you doing?! Are you trying to get yourself killed?!"
Ai: "What's with that tone?! I was told it wouldn't move without two people,
so I came all this way to help you!"
Yamato: "Oh, so that's why it wouldn't start...
Ai: "I don't really understand either, but anyway,
it seems this mech's the only thing that can stand up to him,
Lyle: "...I never imagined someone could do this much in an Armored Mech...
Ai: "Yes! This is amazing! It's working!"
Yamato: "It looks like Touya is the main pilot,
while Ai shares the piloting by handling the control systems."
Yamato: "Hey! This isn't the time to be
Let's settle our fight from back then!
Lyle: "I'll defeat you with my own hands!"
Lyle: "Ghh! So the adjustments still aren't complete...?
Next time we meet, you're finished! Remember that!"
Ai: "All right! And don't come back!"
Touya: "Hah... Hah... Hah... You've still got plenty of energy..."
